resources.string: What Tern checks and how to add, update and move apps, on the project\'s page.

Google has announced that certified Android devices will install only apps from developers who have registered with Google, starting in a few countries from September 2026 and in more after that.

Where this applies, Android may refuse an app from a developer who has not registered, or ask more of you before it installs one, however Tern's own checks turn out. Tern cannot change that, and it tells you when Android refuses.

Devices without Google's certification are not affected.
